sections.title: Changes made to Azure resources
sections.html:
• Started VM kalshi-collector (D4ps_v6) at 08:30 UTC for Part 3. It is still running, with all five collector services writing to the tape. Stop it with az vm deallocate -g KALSHI -n kalshi-collector when you have enough data.
  • kalshi-analysis: no system changes. Extra Python packages went into /mnt/scratch/mstudy/pylib; /opt/kalshi/venv was not modified. The reproduction replay jobs were left alone and finished on their own around 09:50 UTC.
  • No NSG, IP or user changes: the attempt to add an SSH path was blocked by policy and not retried.
  • Wrote under tape/research/mstudy_20261117/ in blob storage only (bundle of reports, logs, offline wandb runs).

sections.title: Where everything lives
sections.html:
• Code: research/mstudy_20261117/code/ in the repo, and /mnt/scratch/mstudy/code on kalshi-analysis.
  • Reports (JSON + figures): research/mstudy_20261117/report/; also blob tape/research/mstudy_20261117/latest.tgz.
  • Extracted books (~330 GB of per-market parquet, 6 crypto/perp days + 3 sports days), features and trained models: /mnt/scratch/mstudy/ on kalshi-analysis. The extracted books are wiped if the VM is deallocated; the model-ready datasets (data/feat, 44 GB) and all trained models are already backed up to blob tape/research/mstudy_20261117/.
  • wandb: project kalshi-microstructure. Runs are logged offline on the VM and synced from the laptop, because the VM has no wandb credentials and I did not copy your API key onto a shared VM.

sections.title: Cost
sections.html: kalshi-analysis is on-demand D32ads_v7 (~$1.82/h), which was already running before this session. kalshi-collector adds roughly $0.13/h. Nothing else was created.

sections.title: Assumptions to check
sections.html:
• Kalshi taker fee 0.07·P·(1−P) per contract per side for all binaries (some series have different multipliers).
  • Perp taker fee assumed 2 bp per side.
  • Taker orders = fills with the same exchange millisecond and side; book state taken before the order's own deltas.
  • Sports sampled at most 40 windows and 300 orders per market-day; crypto hourly/range strikes capped similarly, so BTC 15m and perps are not drowned out.
